events.text: JoshMemory Record: AIDungeonMaster/DCSPD action pinning complete. Created AIDungeonMaster PR #9 (CI passed) and DCSPD PR #7 (CI failed exclusively due to expected npm audit step). Dependency exposure matrix built for Next.js, nanoid, postcss across the portfolio. None of the vulnerabilities are exploitable (No Server Actions in Next.js apps, no customAlphabet/customRandom in nanoid usage, no processing of arbitrary user CSS in PostCSS). All correctly reclassified in the queue as PACKAGE VULNERABLE / NOT REACHABLE. SecurityAudit/PORTFOLIO_RISK_REGISTER updated. No package upgrades performed.
